svg.title: Neural Network Field Guide

text.font-family: Poppins, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 42 architectures and training schemes, from the perceptron (1958) to diffusion LLMs (2025).

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each diagram draws a network in miniature, from input at the bottom to output at the top. In most panels, a circle is one neuron; in sequence models, where each column is a

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: token, it is that token's whole vector at one layer. A square is larger: an image patch, an expert network, a matrix-valued state. A cell's color and mark both show its role, so the

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: diagrams read with or without color. Faded cells and links take little or no part in the step shown. Links show which tokens can read which. Wherever a part repeats, across

text.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: positions, windows, copies, or passes, it uses the same weights. Each panel gives a year and the objective or learning rule of its original paper; many can be trained other ways.
